one_line: An aesthetic analysis demonstrating how lip volume alters the visual proportions of the lower face using interactive split-screen comparisons.

hook.what_happens: A split-screen comparison of a model's face with thin versus full lips, challenging the viewer's perception of lip size.
hook.why_it_works: Directly addresses a common insecurity with a subtle, realistic visual demonstration.

shots.description: Split-screen portrait of Sydney Sweeney showing unmodified vs. edited lip volume with overlay lines indicating facial proportions.
Close-up on the nose-to-lip gap, comparing the distance between thin and full lip variations.
Focus shifts to the chin area, highlighting how lip volume changes the perceived strength of the jawline.
shots.layout: split-screen portrait with highlighted chin area

shots.description: An interactive slider moves across the face to show a continuous transition of lip volume.
Profile view of the model rotating to show the 3D impact of the lip volume change.
Side-by-side comparison of the full face with thin and full lips, emphasizing the concept of 'load-bearing' features.
Text-based instructions prompting the viewer to try a physical exercise to see the effect on their own face.
Call to action showing a search bar typing out the brand name.

devices.name: split-screen slider
devices.what_it_is: A vertical dividing line showing two different states of the same image.
devices.used_for: Comparing unmodified and edited facial features.

devices.name: measurement brackets
devices.used_for: Showing the physical distance between facial landmarks.

devices.name: interactive slider
devices.what_it_is: A UI slider element at the bottom of the screen.
devices.used_for: Demonstrating a range of volume adjustments.

onscreen_text.text: This is the mouth you're picturing.
And it was never about size.
The lower third is read from here
They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone.
It measures the gaps around it.
Move the lip line and every gap moves.
NOSE BASE TO LIP EDGE, MEASURED
Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long.
The chin isn't what changed either.
Watch the gap, not the lips.
None of this means fuller is better.
On many faces, less is the change.
Roll your lips inward and hold
You will not get that mouth.
See it on your own face first.

transcript.text: Think your lips are too thin? This is the mouth you're picturing.
And it was never about size.
Lips are not a feature. They are the line the lower face is measured from.
Your eye never measures a feature alone. It measures the gaps around it.
Move the lip line and every gap moves.
One. The gap between nose and lip. Full lips make it short. Thin lips, long.
Two. The chin reads stronger. The chin isn't what changed either.
Here is that range, on one face. Watch the gap, not the lips.
Now turn it. A front photograph hides it.
None of this means fuller is better. It means lips are load-bearing.
On many faces, less is the change.
Do this now. Roll your lips inward and hold. Watch your chin arrive.
You will not get that mouth. See it on your own face first.

narrative_arc: Challenge the viewer's assumption about lip size.
Introduce the concept of facial proportions and 'gaps'.
Demonstrate how lip volume changes the nose-to-lip gap.
Demonstrate how lip volume changes the perception of the chin.
Show the 3D reality of these changes.
Provide an interactive physical test for the viewer.
Introduce the product as a tool to preview these changes on oneself.

cta.what: Search Refina AI to preview changes on your own face.

subjects: Sydney Sweeney (Model used for facial proportion demonstration)
what_makes_it_work: Uses a highly recognizable celebrity face to ground the demonstration.
Focuses on objective geometry and spatial relationships rather than subjective beauty standards.
Includes an immediate physical interactive element ('Do this now') to engage the viewer.

animations.name: SliderReveal
animations.what_moves: Vertical divider line sweeps across the face, revealing modified lip volume.
animations.purpose: Demonstrates subtle difference between unmodified and modified lip sizes.
animations.reusable_as: Before/after comparisons for skincare, makeup, or dental treatments.

animations.name: TrimPath Measurement Lines
animations.what_moves: Horizontal measurement lines draw out from the center.
animations.purpose: Visually defines anatomical boundaries of the lower face.
animations.reusable_as: Highlighting dimensions or structural alignments in technical diagrams.

animations.name: Highlight Box
animations.what_moves: A white rectangular frame scales up slightly and fades in.
animations.purpose: Focuses viewer attention on the spatial gap rather than the lips.
animations.reusable_as: Framing key details in product shots or highlighting text blocks.

animations.name: Measurement Arrows
animations.what_moves: Vertical dimension lines with arrowheads draw on.
animations.purpose: Quantifies and compares physical distance changes.
animations.reusable_as: Showing height, depth, or thickness changes in product comparisons.

animations.name: ContourDraw Chin Oval
animations.what_moves: A dotted oval draws around the chin area.
animations.purpose: Isolates and draws attention to the chin's appearance.
animations.reusable_as: Circling key ingredients or specific features in a demonstration.

animations.name: Interactive Slider Simulation
animations.what_moves: A slider handle moves horizontally, updating the split-screen divider in sync.
animations.purpose: Simulates a user-controlled interface showing continuous volume range.
animations.reusable_as: Demonstrating app UI controls or gradual transformations.

animations.name: ConvergePanels Transition
animations.what_moves: Front-facing portrait splits and wipes away as side-profile slides in.
animations.purpose: Transitions from front to side view while maintaining split-screen motif.
animations.reusable_as: Showing different angles of a product or a before/after transition.

animations.name: AnimatedCheckList
animations.what_moves: A numbered list of instructions appears sequentially.
animations.purpose: Guides viewer through a physical exercise to test the video's theory.
animations.reusable_as: Step-by-step tutorials, feature lists, or recipe instructions.

animations.name: Search Bar Typing
animations.what_moves: A search bar fades in, and text is typed out letter-by-letter.
animations.purpose: Provides a clear call-to-action directing users to search for the brand.
animations.reusable_as: Outro cards, search-intent demonstrations, or brand name reveals.

animation_language_summary.how_things_enter: Elements fade in or draw on using clean, linear paths.
animation_language_summary.how_things_leave: Elements wipe away or fade out abruptly during scene cuts.
animation_language_summary.how_scenes_change: Hard cuts or split-screen panel transitions.
animation_language_summary.what_stays_still: The central portrait subject remains static while overlays animate around it.
animation_language_summary.rhythm: Bursty, with periods of static analysis punctuated by dynamic slider sweeps.

what_we_should_steal: Interactive Slider Simulation to mimic real-time app usage
TrimPath measurement lines for scientific/technical credibility
